name: Happy Path — Branch Cash Deposit with AML Threshold Report
description: Customer deposits £12,000 cash at branch. Staff verify identity. Cash counted. Deposit posted. AML threshold report generated (>£10,000). Account credited. Vault reconciled at close.

steps.action: Present £12,000 cash for deposit; provide ID
Verify customer identity per CDD; count and verify cash via machine
Create CashDepositTransaction (ENT-077); amount 12000 > 10000 → aml_threshold_exceeded: true; generate aml_report_ref
Consume EVT-166 → Queue AML threshold report for MLRO review
Consume EVT-166 → Write immutable AML threshold record
Credit customer account; update CashDepositTransaction status=credited
201 Created {transaction_id, status: credited, aml_threshold_exceeded: true, aml_report_ref}
Issue deposit receipt; inform customer deposit confirmed
End of day: vault cash reconciliation submitted
Vault reconciliation confirmed; surplus prepared for cash centre
